verdicts.reason: Both shrink the two illustration clusters to tiny, unreadable thumbnails floating mid-canvas with huge dead navy areas, losing the original's lively framing. A pushes 'CREATIVE AGENCY' to the very bottom, about 350px from 'CLAYTONI', so the tagline is cut off from its wordmark. B keeps the tagline closer to the logo, which groups them a little better, but it breaks the tagline onto two lines for no reason and makes it bigger, so it competes with the wordmark. Both still have large empty bands.
